_original_lore: The Pack Enforcer is a Sven Packmaster Miniboss
that has a small chance to be spawned upon killing
a Wolf During a Sven Packmaster Tier III Quest.
name: 狼群执法者 (小首领)

source: The Pack Enforcer is a Sven Packmaster Miniboss
that has a small chance to be spawned upon killing
a Wolf During a Sven Packmaster Tier III Quest.
loreParagraphs.translation: 狼群执法者是斯文狼王的小首领,在斯文狼王 III 级任务期间击杀狼时有小概率生成.
